text:
deploy-bot: Tag rwinf/v3.4.1-rc1 created for commit 7a1b2c3d. Brief changelog: improved batching heuristics, KV-cache bugfix for long-prefixes, quantized kernel fallback for some transformer blocks. Canary plan: 10% traffic in us-west-2 for 30m. Rollback thresholds: error rate > 2% OR p95 latency +50ms vs baseline. Please pin any downstream test fixtures now. Links: https://redwood.internal/changelogs/rwinf/v3.4.1

deploy-bot: ```
# git tag locally (for traceability)
git tag -a rwinf/v3.4.1-rc1 7a1b2c3d -m "rwinf v3.4.1-rc1"
# deploybot will handle the rollout
```

celeste: Any DB/migration steps? Need to update partner docs if there are behavioral changes. :mag_right:

ops-liz: No DB migrations. I'll patch the k8s pin for canaries and update /ops/releases/pins.yaml now. Will also add a short note to the oncall playbook. :white_check_mark:

rahul: FYI the quantized fallback touches kernel selection for long sequences — watching rerank quality closely. QE run: prompt_set_3 and rerank_sanity. If rerank success drops >5% consider rollback.

qe-lee: Running smoke + rerank set now (kickoff 2176543305). ETA ~12m, posting results here.

marta: Heads up — infra maintenance scheduled in eu-west-1 in ~1h. Can we hold EU prod rollout by +2h? Prefer to avoid overlapping changes. :rotating_light:

ops-liz: Acknowledged, will scope rollout regions. Starting canary in US only. Pin request to docs/product to delay EU.

sre-bot: Synthetic checks created for this canary: /integrations/canary/rwinf_v3_4_1. Alerts configured to #incidents with thresholds: error_rate > 1.5% (warning), 2% (critical). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rwinf/canary-rwinf-v3.4.1

deploy-bot: Canary started @ 2176543850 — 10% traffic directed to rwinf/v3.4.1-rc1 in us-west-2. Observability streaming to canary dashboard.

celeste: :shipit: watching logs for any 5xx spikes.

qe-lee: Smoke results (2176543920): all checks green except one rerank case intermittently failing (flaky). Investigating sample traces.

rahul: If rerank regression persists across the full prompt set, we'll trigger rollback. For now, continue monitoring.

sre-bot: No alert fires so far; latency p95 is +12ms vs baseline (within threshold). Error rate stable at 0.4%.

ops-liz: Pin updated in k8s and deployment annotations set to rwinf/v3.4.1-rc1 (canary).

deploy-bot: Canary complete @ 2176544130 — metrics stable. Promoting tag rwinf/v3.4.1-rc1 to stable for us-west-2 and us-east-1. EU regions held per marta until maintenance window clears. Release notes posted: https://redwood.internal/releases/rwinf/v3.4.1. If anyone sees unexpected regressions please @ops-liz + @rahul and we will evaluate rollback. :tada:
